name: wordpress-pp-mcp
description: Publish and manage WordPress pages, posts, media

wordpress_basic_auth.title: WORDPRESS_BASIC_AUTH
wordpress_basic_auth.description: Sets WORDPRESS_BASIC_AUTH for the Wordpress MCP server.

wordpress_base_url.title: Wordpress API base URL
wordpress_base_url.description: Base URL for the Wordpress API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

wordpress_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
wordpress_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

wordpress_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
wordpress_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on WordPress requests (some hosts and security plugins block unfamiliar agents). Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
